Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Billion-cell mesh decomposition and High-order spectral-element and FR methods. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) solver) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
